BETA
Core commands use the deterministic catalogue and Vite/React export. The linter, ingestion, resource scaffolder and contribution gate are Beta. Ingestion provides partial AST-based route/JSX structure only: it leaves source untouched and does not infer product intent, navigation behavior, business logic, CSS Modules or dynamic styles. The linter reports static heuristic findings and does not certify rendered accessibility; color findings are review-only.
← Back to Documentation
Tessellate CLI (`tess`)

A private workspace CLI for searching the catalogue, composing and validating manifests, and generating standalone Vite/React source. It is not published on npm.

Build from a Tessellate checkout

The package is private and is not available from npm. From the repository root, build the bundled catalogue and CLI:

pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build:catalog
pnpm --filter @tessellate/cli build
node packages/cli/dist/index.cjs --help
Commands
tess add <slug>

Resolves a resource from a local or configured registry and writes its files into the configured components directory.

tess add metric-card
tess add ai-chat-panel --overwrite
tess search [query]

Search the 324-resource open catalogue directly from your terminal.

tess search "fintech"
tess search --category "data"
tess validate <file>

Validates a local ResourceManifest or ProjectManifest against canonical Zod schemas.

tess validate ./resources/my-card/manifest.json
tess export [project-file]

Generates a standalone Vite + React + Tailwind project from a ProjectManifest. Next.js and native targets are not selected by this CLI command.

tess export project.tess.json --output ./my-app

Other core commands include init, view, compose, and doctor. See tess --help for their options and for the separately labelled Beta commands.
